module.purpose: Provides a React hook that resolves image or video assets to scale-appropriate URLs, temporary previews, or export-ready resources for shapes and SVG export.
module.summary: This module integrates editor asset resolution with React state and lifecycle management. It selects an asset URL based on canvas zoom, displayed width, and SVG export settings; avoids work for culled shapes; uses temporary previews for locally pasted assets; debounces repeated resolution requests; and prevents stale asynchronous callbacks from updating state after cleanup.
module.businessContext: Supports efficient rendering of uploaded media in the collaborative canvas. Failures can leave images or videos missing, stale, incorrectly scaled, or unavailable during export.

preconditions: The supplied editor must provide asset lookup, preview lookup, zoom, culling, tick subscription, and export-related scheduling APIs used by the hook.
The asset identifier, when present, must identify an image or video asset or be handled as a missing asset.
postconditions: The returned state contains the latest accepted asset reference and resolved URL, or null values when the asset is unavailable.
A changed or newly resolved URL updates state and invokes exportIsReady.
Repeated resolution of the same URL does not update state or invoke exportIsReady.
invariants: Updates from an effect that has been cancelled after remount do not modify state.
When a shape is culled and exportInfo is absent, asset resolution is skipped.
Asset identifier changes cause the next resolution to run immediately rather than being debounced.
After the first successful URL resolution, subsequent resolution requests are debounced unless the asset identifier changed.
The previously accepted URL is used to suppress redundant state updates.
edgeCases: When assetId is absent, the effect performs no asset resolution.
When the asset cannot be found, the result asset and URL are set to null.
When an asset has no source but has a temporary preview, the preview becomes the URL and is marked as a placeholder; normal URL resolution is skipped.
When the same URL is resolved again, the existing result is retained.
When the hook effect is cleaned up before resolution completes, the pending result is ignored.
When a non-export shape is culled, resolution is skipped until the effect runs under applicable conditions.
After the initial or asset-change resolution, later scale or size-driven resolutions wait for the debounce interval before invoking URL resolution.

units.name: resolve
units.source:
if (isCancelled) return // don't update if the hook has remounted
				if (previousUrl.current === url) return // don't update the state if the url is the same
				didAlreadyResolve.current = true // mark that we've resolved our first image
				previousUrl.current = url // keep the url around to compare with the next one
				setResult({ asset, url })
				exportIsReady() // let the SVG export know we're ready for export
			}

detail.name: resolve
preconditions: The resolution callback has access to the current cancellation state, previously recorded URL, resolved asset, resolved URL, result setter, and export readiness callback.
postconditions: If cancelled, no state, reference, or export-readiness update is performed.
If the resolved URL equals the previously recorded URL, no state, reference, or export-readiness update is performed.
Otherwise, the resolved state contains the asset and URL, the resolution is marked as completed, the URL is recorded, and export readiness is signaled.
invariants: A cancelled resolution cannot update the hook state.
A URL already recorded as previous is not applied again.
Export readiness is signaled only after a non-cancelled, changed URL is accepted.
edgeCases: When the resolution has been cancelled, the function returns without applying the resolved asset.
When the resolved URL matches the previously recorded URL, the function returns without changing the result.
When the resolution is active and the URL differs from the previous URL, the asset and URL are stored and export readiness is notified.
stateMutations: Sets the resolved result to an object containing the asset and URL.
Marks the first image resolution as completed.
Records the resolved URL for subsequent duplicate checks.
eventsEmitted: Signals SVG export readiness through exportIsReady after accepting a changed URL.
detail.summary: Resolves an asset URL and updates the hook result only when the resolution is still active and produces a URL different from the previously recorded URL. Successful first-time resolution also signals that SVG export is ready.

detail.name: resolveAssetUrl
detail.signature: function resolveAssetUrl(editor: Editor, assetId: TLAssetId, screenScale: number, exportInfo: SvgExportContext | null, callback: (url: string | null) => void)
preconditions: callback accepts a string or null.
postconditions: editor.resolveAssetUrl is invoked with the assetId and derived resolution options.
When the editor resolution fulfills, callback is invoked exactly once with the resolved string or null.
invariants: The callback is invoked asynchronously after the editor resolution promise fulfills.
edgeCases: When exportInfo is null, shouldResolveToOriginal is false and dpr is undefined.
When exportInfo is present with pixelRatio equal to null, shouldResolveToOriginal is true and dpr is undefined.
When exportInfo is present with a non-null pixelRatio, shouldResolveToOriginal is false and dpr is that pixel ratio.
If editor.resolveAssetUrl resolves to null, callback receives null.
If editor.resolveAssetUrl rejects, no callback handling or fallback is performed by this function.
detail.summary: Resolves an asset URL through the editor and delivers the resulting URL, including null, to the supplied callback. Export context controls whether the original asset and export pixel ratio are requested.

The editor receives shouldResolveToOriginal true, dpr undefined, and screenScale 1.5; the callback is later called with null.
